correctness.rationale: A proved fiber-privacy lemma yields the sharp upper bound by exact coordinate-fiber counting. Uniform explicit constructions attain the bound for all q, and direct exhaustive descendant checks verify the constructions for q=2 through 30.

originality.rationale: The located literature gives the odd-q length-three construction and later exact work at length four, but searches did not locate the exact all-q length-three formula, the even-q optimum, or the fiber-privacy upper-bound argument. Originality is to the best of our knowledge with an explicit residual terminology/source risk.

value.rationale: The theorem determines M_TA(3,q,2) for every alphabet size, proves the known odd-q construction optimal, supplies the even-q optimum, and fixes the exact asymptotic leading constant at length three.
